Error: cleo requires Node.js >= 24.16.0
You are running Node 22.23.3 (linux/x64).

Node 24.16.0 bundles the SQLite WAL-reset corruption fix CLEO's
persistence layer (node:sqlite, zero native deps) depends on. Older 24.x
builds pass a major-only check but diverge at runtime (e.g. sqlite_master
DEFENSIVE-mode handling), causing local results to differ from CI.

Update to proceed:
    curl -fsSL https://fnm.vercel.app/install | bash && fnm install 24.16.0

Other options:
  (nodesource) # see https://github.com/nodesource/distributions
